Container.Name: Chrysopoeia
Container.Overview: Chrysopoeia converts your movie and TV library to smaller or more compatible formats (AV1, HEVC, H.264 or VP9) in the background, and replaces an original only after the new file has been fully decoded and visually compared against it. Set Media to the share that holds your videos, then pick a folder and a goal in the web UI; hardware encoders and the number of jobs to run at once are detected automatically. Intel or AMD graphics: install the Intel GPU TOP or Radeon TOP plugin, then click "Add another Path, Port, Variable, Label or Device" below, choose Config Type Device and enter /dev/dri as the Value. NVIDIA: install the Nvidia-Driver plugin, add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters (Advanced View) and set NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES (under Show more settings) to all.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface. There is no login yet: keep it on your network, or put a proxy that adds one in front of it.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database and settings. Small; include it in your appdata backup. Use a folder of its own, not /mnt/user/appdata itself, which other apps share.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: The share that holds your videos, e.g. /mnt/user/media/ (click the field to browse). Choose only what you want converted, not all of /mnt/user/: Chrysopoeia replaces files here, so keep other apps' folders (appdata, photos, camera recordings) out.

Config.Name: Transcode cache
Config.Description: Optional: an SSD/cache-pool folder for in-progress files, e.g. /mnt/cache/chrysopoeia-temp/. Leave empty to write work files next to each original.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id files are written as. Unraid default: 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id files are written as. Unraid default: 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for what Chrysopoeia creates itself (work files, folders in an output folder). 002 lets the users group edit them. A converted file keeps the permissions of the original it replaces.

Config.Name: HW_ACCEL
Config.Description: auto (recommended) uses the best hardware encoder that passes a test encode, else the CPU. cpu never uses the GPU. nvenc (NVIDIA), qsv (Intel) or vaapi (Intel or AMD) uses only that kind of GPU; when it is missing or cannot encode the chosen format, files are converted on the CPU, so check Settings, Hardware: under Details, each format that passed its test encode shows Works. Used on the first start and on the next start whenever you change this value; in between, the choice under Settings, Hardware in the app is kept. auto never overrides that choice.

Config.Name: MAX_JOBS
Config.Description: Files to convert at once, 1 to 32. Empty = automatic, based on CPU cores, memory and GPU. A number here replaces the automatic count while Files at once is set to Automatic in the app (Settings, Processing); a number chosen there wins.

Config.Name: ALLOWED_HOSTS
Config.Description: Only needed behind a reverse proxy (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik): the domain name you open Chrysopoeia at, e.g. transcode.example.com (several: separate with commas). The server's IP address and local names such as tower or tower.local always work without it. A hand-written nginx config must also keep the Host header (proxy_set_header Host $http_host).

Config.Name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
Config.Description: NVIDIA only: all, or one GPU's UUID from Settings, Nvidia Driver to use only that card. Also add --runtime=nvidia to Extra Parameters.
